text: The application is healthy with no current errors.
Requests complete successfully and the service is up.
Monitoring reports normal operation across all components.
The service is running normally and dashboards show no errors.
All endpoints respond successfully; no incidents are active.

rationale: Negation explicitly denies a current database failure.

text: The login service is healthy and is not rejecting credentials.
There is no disk full alert and writes are completing.
rationale: The disk-full cue is explicitly denied.

text: The service is not healthy: database connections time out.
rationale: A current database failure is explicit despite the negated health claim.

text: Database timeouts occurred yesterday, but connections work now.
rationale: The failure is historical and explicitly resolved; no current issue is labeled.

text: The disk was full last week; it has been cleared and writes now succeed.
rationale: The past fault is resolved and current writes succeed.

text: An invalid token caused errors earlier; current logins succeed.
rationale: Only historical authentication errors are reported; current state is successful.

text: Some requests are slow, but there are no connection errors.
rationale: Slowness alone does not identify a database failure; needs review.

text: Storage usage is high, though writes still work and no alert fired.
rationale: High utilization does not establish exhausted storage.

text: A few users report trouble accessing the page.
rationale: Access trouble has no credential-specific evidence; needs review.

text: Database connections time out, and writes fail because the disk is full.
rationale: Two simultaneous categories are explicit; needs review.

text: Login credentials are rejected while the database is unavailable.
rationale: Two simultaneous categories are explicit; needs review.

text: Please schedule a team lunch for Friday.
rationale: Unrelated request provides no service condition; needs review.

text: The office printer needs a new toner cartridge.
rationale: Non-incident input is outside the four labels; needs review.

text: We saw an issue earlier, but no details were recorded.
rationale: No category or current state can be inferred.

text: Users say the app feels odd, with no error or symptom details.
rationale: Subjective vague report lacks classifiable evidence.
